title: RTT Environment Block (v1)
description: Minimal environment substrate for RTTcode packets. Defines boundary, drift, and ambient conditions required for coherent micro-regime evaluation.

boundary.description: Defines the structural limits within which micro-regimes operate.

min.description: Lower bound of the environment’s allowable state space.

max.description: Upper bound of the environment’s allowable state space.

ambient.description: Ambient conditions that influence resonance and timing.

temperature.description: Ambient temperature or analogous scalar affecting micro-state stability.

noise.description: Environmental noise level affecting drift accumulation.

max_drift.description: Maximum allowable drift before coherence collapse.

accumulation_rate.description: Rate at which drift accumulates under ambient conditions.
